item.title: Mother tried to protect daughter's property rights in 1987; 39 years later, court rules against her
item.description: A property transfer made by a Queens mother in 1987 led to a legal dispute nearly four decades later. Mary Mangiaracina had tried to secure lifetime rights to the Ridgewood property for herself and her daughter. However, after the property was sold to new owners, her daughter challenged the sale-related ownership claims in court. In April 2026, a New York appeals court ruled that the daughter had never legally received those lifetime rights. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Brad Paisley and wife pledged $1 million for a free grocery store in 2024; it opened in 2026
item.description: Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Retirement Fuels Bushland Restoration: Ken and Jill revive 970ha bush; older Australians follow
item.description: In their eighties, Ken and Jill Hooper have become dedicated stewards of bushland in Australia, showcasing an inspiring commitment to conservation post-retirement. Over the last twenty years, after acquiring properties in Victoria and New South Wales, they focus on enhancing biodiversity and curbing invasive species to safeguard native wildlife. Their work reflects a significant trend of older Australians contributing to community conservation, aiming to foster a legacy for future generations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Katie Zacharia's brief tenure as White House press secretary ended abruptly after just five days due to a rocky start marked by an underwhelming briefing and questions regarding her qualifications. item.title: Islandwide Power Outage: Sri Lanka hit by multi-hour blackout; hydropower failure probed
item.description: Sri Lanka faced a significant power outage that affected the entire island for over three hours. Essential services such as water supply, internet, and mobile connectivity were disrupted during this time. Authorities are investigating the cause, with a potential failure at a hydropower station being considered. Citizens were warned to conserve water due to the impact on supplies from power cuts. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

The protests began last month at high schools in Paris’ poor northern suburbs, where anger over teacher absences and shabby facilities quickly morphed into a nationwide movement against inequality, weak public spending and falling standards. item.title: 10 killed in fire at seaside resort in Bangladesh
item.description: At least 10 people were killed and nine injured after a fire gutted a three-storey seaside resort in Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar district early Saturday, The Express Tribune reported. The blaze broke out around 6.30am at TUPTUP Resto and Resort, built mainly of bamboo and wood. The cause remains unknown, while several people’s whereabouts were unclear. Injured victims were taken to hospital. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.description: When a couple from Xinjiang took their quintuplets home on a 36-hour train journey, the babies became favourites of both the train crew and fellow passengers, who took turns caring for them. The five babies were born on February 26 at a major hospital in Wuhan, in central China’s Hubei province. Their father, known as Abu, and their mother, Dili, are both from Hotan in northwestern China’s Xinjiang region. The 24-year-old mother conceived naturally despite having previously been diagnosed with... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Is China’s Shenzhen ready to host Xi, Trump and Putin during Apec summit?
item.description: In Shenzhen, drones are banned, shiny new hotels have opened their doors and taxi drivers are carrying devices that can translate nearly 150 languages. Since President Xi Jinping announced last year that China’s southern tech hub would host Apec meetings in November, the city has done all it can to get ready under the watchful eyes of the local, provincial and national authorities. While every Apec summit draws the world’s attention, this year’s edition is considered to be especially high-stakes... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: US ranchers win pipeline compensation fight but face $300,000 legal bill, Supreme Court to hear case
item.description: A group of North Dakota ranchers who spent nearly $300,000 fighting a pipeline company over land compensation have taken their dispute over legal expenses to the US Supreme Court. item.title: Stephen King’s $3 million pledge helped transform hometown library into a $9.6 million project
item.description: Stephen and Tabitha King have committed $3 million to the Bangor Public Library renovation, provided that $6 million is raised through community efforts. Thanks to local support and a municipal bond, the library hit its $9 million target, kickstarting essential upgrades like roof repairs and improved community spaces, honoring both its historical significance and modern audience requirements. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Forgotten John Constable Painting: $37 buy authenticated at $315,000; other 2024 finds hidden in plain sight
item.description: Hidden away in a cupboard for years, a painting believed to be by John Constable was recently found and has skyrocketed in value from its auction price of $37 to an astounding $315,000. This extraordinary revelation joins the ranks of remarkable discoveries, like a rare Lego mask and a Victorian brooch, which emphasize that ordinary objects can possess extraordinary worth. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Snakes Found Inside Airport: Venomous western browns spotted in terminal; experts explain heat-driven visits
item.description: As summer approaches, Alice Springs Airport is preparing for an influx of snake sightings, with multiple reports emerging from terminal areas. Travelers are encouraged to remain alert and immediately report any sightings to airport personnel, emphasizing safety first in this reptilian season. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
